ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Based on the given food web diagram, what would likely happen if the population of earthworms increases?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image is a soil food web, with an earthworm node labeled “EARTHWORMS” slightly right of center; in the upper right there is a bird node labeled “BIRDS.” A red food relationship arrow connects earthworms and birds, indicating that birds can feed on earthworms. Reasoning: The question asks what will happen if the earthworm population increases. According to food web rules, an increase in the amount of food or prey will allow the animals that prey on it to obtain more available food. Therefore, an increase in earthworms will provide more food for birds.
